title: Buitre leonado (Gyps fulvus)
author: Thomas SIGNEAU
changes: Griffon vulture (Gyps fulvus) cackling and hissing, a field recording from France shared through Xeno-canto (XC917400). Trimmed to 1.50–4.30 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 100 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 1.5 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. The high-pass is set to 100 Hz because the field recording has wind rumble below 100 Hz that is as loud as the calls; the calls themselves are above 800 Hz.
